description: Create a worktree from origin/main (355e421). Add Benchee as a dev-only dependency and bench scripts for mount, unchanged update, one leaf state update, keyed append/prepend/reverse/remove/clear, and observable write through rendered Phoenix diff. Use 10/100/1000 rows. Isolate preconditions/setup and correctness validation from timed work; each observable sample must finish all delivery/rendering and clean up subscriptions. Provide a small compatibility boundary for current Observable and substrate Cell APIs without changing workload semantics. Record JSON summaries including timing, allocations, reductions, wire diff bytes, message/update counts, and environment/git/lock/harness metadata. Include smoke verification in CI without speed thresholds, commands/docs, and a repeatable comparison tool. Validate full tests and existing checks, then open a separate draft PR targeting main.
title: Build a main-based Benchee harness with verified shared workloads
